title: 68th OPEC+ Joint Ministerial Monitoring Committee (JMMC)
source: EST: opec.org press release 2026-08-02 (67th JMMC) states verbatim 'The next meeting of the JMMC (68th) is scheduled for 4 October 2026' — primary-sourced but filed estimate per the event-research lane's no-self-confirm limit, checked 2026-08-31
notes: The successor checkpoint to opec-plus-meeting-2026-09-06, and deliberately filed `low`: the JMMC monitors DoC conformity and compensation and RECOMMENDS — it does not set quotas, which is the seven/eight-country group's job. What makes it worth tracking anyway is the 2027 baseline fight: third-party Maximum-Sustainable-Capacity audits commissioned across Jan-Sep 2026 set the 2027 baselines from which every quota derives, Iraq is pushing for a higher individual number, and Kazakhstan carries the alliance's largest cumulative compensation burden — the JMMC is where conformity and compensation get aired in public before the group decides. Discovered during the opec-plus-meeting-2026-09-06 initial research (2026-08-31).
